content.text:
I can’t open or verify the attached PDF from here, so I can’t read the Q2 board pack pages directly. I may be missing specifics from the actual slides — if you paste the revenue and churn pages or key numbers I’ll summarize them precisely. Below is a concise checklist and a ready-to-use, short-summary template to extract what matters from those pages yourself (and what I’ll produce if you paste the content).

State of uncertainty: I’m unable to inspect the PDF file, so anything below is guidance rather than a direct read of your board pack.

What to look for on the revenue pages
- Top-line metrics: total revenue for the quarter, revenue growth (QoQ and YoY).
- Recurring revenue metrics: ARR or annualized MRR, current MRR, net new ARR/MRR for the quarter.
- Revenue composition: % recurring vs non-recurring, product/segment/channel splits, top customers contributing large shares.
- Bookings vs recognized revenue: new bookings and backlog if shown.
- Expansion vs contraction: expansion revenue (upsells), downgrades, and one-time losses.
- Variance vs plan/forecast: actual vs plan (and vs last quarter), with commentary on drivers.
- Profitability/margin context if present: gross margin or contribution.
- Any forward guidance or changes to outlook.

What to look for on the churn pages
- Types of churn shown: logo (customer) churn and MRR/revenue churn (gross and net).
- Gross churn rate vs net churn (net churn = gross churn minus expansion); churn in % and absolute $ terms if available.
- Cohort retention visuals: retention after 3/6/12 months, cohort curves.
- Churn drivers: reasons listed (pricing, product gaps, competitor wins, cancellations).
- Customer vs revenue concentration: are churned customers small or large accounts?
- Churn by segment/product/geography if shown.
- Any remediation actions and expected impact (product fixes, account management, pricing changes).

Red flags to call out quickly
- Rising gross churn or rising churn among larger accounts.
- Net churn > 0 (meaning revenue is declining from existing base despite expansion).
- Declining ARR or slowing ARR growth QoQ while bookings stagnate.
- Large portion of revenue from a handful of customers (concentration risk).
- Guidance downgraded or negative trending outlook.

Concise summary template you can fill or I’ll use if you paste numbers
- Revenue: “[Quarter] revenue was [X], up/down [Y]% YoY and [Z]% QoQ. ARR/MRR is [A]. Net new ARR this quarter was [B]. Revenue mix: [recurring %] recurring, [non-recurring %] one-time. Major drivers: [top drivers]. Actual vs plan: [beat/miss] by [amount] due to [reasons].”
- Churn: “Gross logo churn was [C]% (or [C] logos), gross revenue churn was [D]%. Expansion offset was [E]%, yielding net churn of [F]%. Cohort retention at 12 months is [G]%. Main churn drivers: [reasons]. Impact: churn led to [impact on revenue/ARR], and mitigation actions are [actions].”

Next steps I can do for you
- If you paste the revenue and churn slides’ text/tables or key numbers, I’ll produce a tight, board-ready paragraph summary and one-sentence risk/ask.
- Or re-upload the PDF and say I may inspect it (I currently can’t access it from this chat).

If you want, paste the revenue and churn tables/charts or the numeric highlights and I’ll summarize them now.
